name: std/json
description: Declares JSON trees and streaming tokens.
readme: Declares JSON trees and streaming tokens.
Import this module with use json.

files.content:
-- Declares JSON trees and streaming tokens.
public define Value as opaque.
public define Stream as opaque.
public use "json" function parse(source of type text) of type fallible pointer to Value.
public use "json" function write(value of type pointer to Value) of type fallible text.
public use "json" function field(value of type pointer to Value, name of type text) of type fallible text.
public use "json" function item(value of type pointer to Value, index of type unsigned 32) of type fallible text.
public use "json" function quote(value of type text) of type fallible text.
public use "json" function kind(value of type pointer to Value) of type text.
public use "json" function size(value of type pointer to Value) of type fallible unsigned 32.
public use "json" function set(value of type pointer to Value, name of type text, source of type text) of type fallible nothing.
public use "json" function append(value of type pointer to Value, source of type text) of type fallible nothing.
public use "json" function release(value of type pointer to Value) of type nothing.
public use "json" function stream() of type fallible pointer to Stream.
public use "json" function feed(value of type pointer to Stream, chunk of type text, final of type boolean) of type fallible nothing.
public use "json" function next(value of type pointer to Stream) of type fallible text.
public use "json" function data(value of type pointer to Stream) of type fallible text.
public use "json" function close(value of type pointer to Stream) of type nothing.
